## All Releases

All published versions, read live from Zenodo. Concept DOI (always the latest version): [`r concept_doi`](https://doi.org/`r concept_doi`)

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('<div id="all-releases" data-concept-doi="%s"><p>Loading releases from Zenodo&hellip;</p></div>', concept_doi))
```

```{=html}
<style>
#all-releases table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
#all-releases th { text-align: left; padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.55rem 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #d7dee6; }
#all-releases td { padding: 0.6rem 1rem 0.6rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7ebef; white-space: nowrap; }
</style>
<script>
(async () => {
  const box = document.getElementById("all-releases");
  const conceptDoi = box.dataset.conceptDoi;
  const conceptId = conceptDoi.match(/(\d+)$/)[1];
  const link = (href, text) => `<a href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${text}</a>`;
  try {
    // ponytail: one page of 25 (Zenodo's anonymous maximum); add paging past 25 versions.
    const response = await fetch(
      `https://zenodo.org/api/records?q=conceptrecid:${conceptId}&all_versions=true&sort=mostrecent&size=25`
    );
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Zenodo returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const records = (await response.json()).hits.hits;
    if (!records.length) throw new Error("no published versions yet");
    const rows = records.map((r) => {
      const pdf = (r.files || []).find((f) => /\.pdf$/i.test(f.key));
      return `<tr><td>${r.metadata.version || "-"}</td><td>${r.metadata.publication_date}</td>` +
        `<td>${link(`https://doi.org/${r.doi}`, r.doi)}</td>` +
        `<td>${pdf ? link(pdf.links.self, "PDF") : "-"}</td><td>${link(r.links.self_html, "Record")}</td></tr>`;
    });
    box.innerHTML = "<table><thead><tr><th>Version</th><th>Release date</th><th>DOI</th>" +
      `<th>Download</th><th>Zenodo</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join("")}</tbody></table>`;
  } catch (error) {
    box.innerHTML = `<p>Could not load the release list (${error.message}). ` +
      `See all versions on Zenodo: ${link(`https://doi.org/${conceptDoi}`, conceptDoi)}</p>`;
  }
})();
</script>
```
